en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from al-Bazanti, from the one he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Then, the one who is urged, (who is) not being transgressing nor hostile» [2:174]. He said: The transgressing is the one who goes out against the Imam, and the hostile is the one who interrupts the road; to them, dead meat (of a non-slaughtered animal) is impermissible.
